evidence: MECHANICS PASS. (1) task/tests/scoring.toml:1-11 is byte-identical to the frozen template (diff empty; sha256 95f70d6e...): [gates] render = 0.0, constraints = 0.0; [weights] functional 0.6 / polish 0.2 / visual 0.2 (gates absent from [weights], so they carry no reward mass); [floors] functional = 0.05. (2) task/tests/tools/score.py (identical to template, sha256 13de2b38...): line 41 gates_passed = all(score > 0.0); lines 42-44 force scored dimensions to 0.0 unless gates passed AND scored/reward.json exists; lines 47-48 reward = weighted only if gates_passed and floors_passed, else 0.0; line 83 exits 1 on gate failure. (3) task/tests/test.sh (identical to template, sha256 bd682592...): lines 60-61 write the zero reward first and trap ensure_reward; line 212 removes stale scored/; lines 213-222 run gates (budget 1500), score.py exit 1 -> exit 0 before the scored suite runs (scored suite skipped), any other non-zero -> write_zero_reward; line 224 runs the scored suite (11100) only after gates pass; a gates timeout exits with the zero record. Budgets nest: 1500 + 11100 = 12600 < task.toml verifier timeout_sec 13200. (4) Gate judges: tests/gates/render/judge.toml and tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml each hold one binary criterion (criterion weight = 1, as the template's 1.0 inside an all_pass dimension; no weight or model in [judge]) with aggregation = 'all_pass', so each gate dimension is 0 or 1. (5) Executed the frozen score.py + scoring.toml copied to a temp dir outside the workspace (python -I -B) on synthetic RewardKit outputs: gate render=0 with perfect scored -> reward 0.0, exit 1; gates pass but no scored file -> 0.0; functional 0.0 with polish=visual=1 -> 0.0 (weighted 0.4 suppressed); functional 0.0328 (one weight-2 criterion) with polish=visual=1 -> 0.0; full -> 1.0. Passing only the cheap gates earns exactly 0 (Internal annotation satisfied). (6) Lesson 4 (keep gates simple: load, reload, server-backed): render gate = wrong-password refusal then Rafael sign-in to a usable workspace (password public in instruction.md:19); constraints gate = UI add candidate, reload, independent-context Observer readback of exactly one card; no stage, conversation or live-update strictness sits in the gates. Lesson 11: a gate NOT EXERCISED returns binary0 and zeros the reward; that is shared harness behaviour, not a task defect. CONCERN (floor farming, P2): the template-fixed functional floor 0.05 is cleared by any two weight-2 functional criteria, (2+2)/61 = 0.0656, and both weight-2 rows can pass without the board's defining behaviour (moving cards). hro_activity's bar says 'A feature graded elsewhere that does not work (for example undo) is left out of this list', so with all moves, rejects and undo broken it only needs lines for the opening (or the seeded-job fallback in tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:21) and the additions; hro_drafts is satisfiable with client-side per-conversation drafts. Synthetic run: functional 0.0656, polish 0.2105, visual 1.0 -> reward 0.2815 (visual supplies 0.2 of it), while an app with working moves, re-order and undo (functional about 0.213) but weak visual (0.25) and no polish scores 0.1779. The floor therefore does not stop an app that cannot move a single card from earning most of its reward from visual/polish. This is bounded (the app must still pass the server-backed gates and really implement an activity log and drafts) and overlaps rows 42 and 44; recorded as Note rather than Fail because row 43's mechanical contract holds byte-for-byte with the template and the floor value is template-controlled. Cross-row observation for row 44 (Lesson 2): functional weights 2-5.5 (total 61) contradict the comment in every judge.toml ('Criterion weights: 1.0 standard, 1.5 important, 2.0 core', e.g. tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:23). MISSING EVIDENCE: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; no real gate-fail or floor-fail RewardKit run exists, so only source reading and synthetic score.py execution back this row.
counterexample: Weak app: sign-in, server-backed add-candidate with independent readback (passes both gates), an Activity view logging job opening and additions, client-side per-conversation drafts, polished styling, but no working stage moves, rejection, undo or messaging. hro_activity (2, broken features left out per its bar) + hro_drafts (2) = 4/61 = 0.0656 > floor 0.05; visual 1.0 -> reward about 0.24-0.28, above a better app with working moves and undo but plain visuals (about 0.18). Conforming alternative that could fail: none found for the gate/floor mechanics; a correct app hit by a judge/tool failure in either gate gets 0 by shared harness design.
suggested_fix: Without touching template scoring, make hro_activity score 0 when no card move of this session succeeded (as hro_readonly_roles already does for missing controls) so the floor cannot be cleared without the core board behaviour, and obtain a real RewardKit run on a gate-failing and a floor-failing mutant to measure the zeroing.
